events.title: SWELL Sculpture Festival
events.description: An outdoor exhibition featuring large-scale sculptures by local and international artists along the Currumbin coastline. It is a community-focused cultural event that encourages exploration and public engagement with art in a natural setting.

events.title: Wil Sargisson Quartet
events.description: An intimate live jazz performance by the Wil Sargisson Quartet, known for their technical skill and classic sound. Ideal for those looking for a sophisticated musical experience in a dedicated performance setting.

events.title: SWELL Masquerade Ball
events.description: A creative evening event hosted by the SWELL festival, combining performance, art, and community socialising in an immersive masquerade setting. This is a ticketed artistic celebration designed for those connected to the local creative arts community.
